properties.id: FILL: mainnet chain id, an integer no other Demos network uses (testnet 1 and devnet 1337 are refused)
properties.name: FILL: network name (testnet: DEMOS)
properties.sudoPubkey: FILL: lowercase 0x + 64 hex key allowed to sign award transactions, or delete this field to accept none

snapshot.manifestSha256: FILL: sha256 of the launch snapshot's manifest.json bytes, or delete this field when mainnet starts without a snapshot

balances: FILL: [["0x<64 hex address>", "<amount>"], ...] the agreed allocations
timestamp: FILL: launch time in seconds, a positive integer string (testnet: "1692734616")
validators: FILL: launch validators, one object each: {"address", "status": "2", "connection_url", "staked_amount", "first_seen": 0, "valid_at": 0}
